title.narrative: Program for Strengthening Institutional Management of the Office of the Attorney General
Programa de Fortalecimiento de la Gestin Institucional de la Procuradura General de la Nacin

description.narrative: Fortalecer el control pblico a travs del mejoramiento de la efectividad de la PGN. Esto se realizar fundamentalmente a travs de: (i) una mejora de la eficiencia y coordinacin de las funciones misionales a travs de un enfoque centrado en un ciclo de control con herramientas de gestin de cambio y mitigacin de riesgos; (ii) el fortalecimiento de la eficiencia en la ejecucin, articulacin y seguimiento de las funciones desconcentradas; y (iii) la promocin de la transparencia e integridad a nivel interno y externo.

The program's objective is to strengthen public oversight by improving the effectiveness of the Office of the Attorney General. Primarily, this will be achieved by: (i) improving the efficiency and coordination of the PGN's mission-related functions through an approach that focuses on an oversight cycle with change management and risk-mitigation tools; (ii) strengthening the efficiency of execution, coordination, and monitoring of decentralized functions; and (iii) promoting internal and external transparency and integrity.
